proposals.before: On renchen, Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Xuan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the throne and rule the myriad people.
proposals.after: On renchen, Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Dan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the throne and rule the myriad people.
proposals.reason: Chinese 夏侯亶 has given name 亶 (Dǎn); English wrongly renders it as Xuan.

proposals.before: On dingsi, Xiao Yinghou was made General of the Right and commander of the rear and garrison forces.
proposals.after: On dingsi, Xiao Yingzhou was made General of the Right and commander of the rear and garrison forces.
proposals.reason: Same person as 蕭穎冑 elsewhere rendered Xiao Yingzhou; Yinghou is an inconsistent transliteration of 胄/冑.

proposals.before: General of the Right Xiao Yinghou was made left chief clerk and advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army; the Prince of Liang was advanced to General Who Subdues the East.
proposals.after: General of the Right Xiao Yingzhou was made left chief clerk and advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army; the Prince of Liang was advanced to General Who Subdues the East.
proposals.reason: Same person as 蕭穎冑 elsewhere rendered Xiao Yingzhou; Yinghou is inconsistent.

proposals.before: On renyin, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Pacifies the Army Xiao Yinghou died; Attendant at the Yellow Gate Xiao Dan was ordered to handle the affairs of Jing Province and the princely establishment.
proposals.after: On renyin, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Pacifies the Army Xiao Yingzhou died; Attendant at the Yellow Gate Xiao Dan was ordered to handle the affairs of Jing Province and the princely establishment.
proposals.reason: Same person as 蕭穎冑 elsewhere rendered Xiao Yingzhou; Yinghou is inconsistent.

proposals.before: On yiwei of the eleventh month of winter, General of the Household for All Purposes Li Yuanyi was made governor of Yu Province.
proposals.after: On yiwei of the eleventh month of winter, General of the Household for All Purposes Li Yuanlü was made governor of Yu Province.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李元履 has 履 (lǚ); Yuanyi does not match the given name.

proposals.before: Another edict said: "I am personally leading the army to destroy these villains; with war at hand, mercy should be spread abroad.
proposals.after: Another edict said: "I am personally leading the host from Jinyang to cut down these criminals; with war at hand, mercy should be spread abroad.
proposals.reason: Chinese 躬率晉陽 names Jinyang; the idiomatic English omits that place.

decisions.reason: Chinese 夏侯亶 gives the personal name 亶 (Dǎn); English Xiahou Xuan misreads it, and Xiahou Dan is the accurate correction while the rest of the sentence is unchanged.
The same 夏侯亶 requires Xiahou Dan in the literal field; Xiahou Xuan is a naming error, and the proposed replacement fixes only that name.
Chinese 蕭穎胄 ends in 胄 (zhòu); Yinghou is a wrong reading, and Xiao Yingzhou matches the graph and the chapter's other renderings of this person.
Unit s0019 again names 蕭穎胄; replacing Yinghou with Yingzhou corrects the transliteration without changing offices or the Prince of Liang clause.
The death notice likewise has 蕭穎胄; Xiao Yingzhou is the correct name, and the rest of the sentence about Xiao Dan is left intact.
Chinese 李元履 has given name 履 (lǚ); Li Yuanyi does not match that character, and Li Yuanlü is the accurate personal-name reading.
Chinese 躬率晉陽 names Jinyang, which the idiomatic omits; the proposed wording restores that place and keeps a faithful rendering of 翦此凶孽 and the mercy clause.
